name: supaforge
description: Find and fix drift between Supabase environments.
long_description: SupaForge compares two Supabase projects — schema, RLS policies, roles and grants, auth, storage, webhooks, cron, vault, migrations and reference data — and gives the SQL to bring them back in line. It reads supaforge.config.json in the project directory you choose; scanning writes nothing, and applying a fix asks first.

project_dir.title: Project directory
project_dir.description: The directory holding supaforge.config.json (run `npx @akal/supaforge init` there to create one).

tools.name: scan_drift
tools.description: Compare two environments and report drift, with the SQL to fix it

tools.name: apply_fixes
tools.description: Apply fixes from a scan to the target environment

tools.name: take_snapshot
tools.description: Snapshot an environment to local files

tools.name: create_migration
tools.description: Write a migration file for the drift found

tools.name: get_check_result
tools.description: Read one check's result from the last scan
